up: Retrieve distinct rows with molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, compound_records.compound_name, and compound_structures.canonical_smiles for all molecules associated with the document having chembl_id 'CHEMBL1138844'. The document is in the docs table. Connect docs to compound_records via doc_id, then compound_records to molecule_dictionary via molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures via molregno. Only include molecules where canonical_smiles is not null (i.e., compound_structures exists and has a non-null canonical_smiles). Order the results by chembl_id, then compound_name, then canonical_smiles. Do not apply any additional filters such as on activity values or units. Return all matching rows without any limit.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cr.compound_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1138844'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
